intent.raw_query: Nepal trekking Annapurna, $2000 solo, October 2026, 14 days

experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m. Trek through rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and glacial moraines while enjoying breathtaking views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli. The trail passes through traditional Gurung villages offering authentic cultural immersion alongside stunning Himalayan scenery.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of the most spectacular sunrises in the Himalayas. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a panoramic 180-degree view. The 2-hour ascent from Ghorepani is manageable for most fitness levels and rewards trekkers with unforgettable Himalayan vistas.

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Homestay
experiences.description: Stay overnight with a local Gurung family in a traditional stone house in Ghandruk village. Share home-cooked dal bhat, gundruk soup, and raksi (local millet wine) while learning about Gurung customs, traditional dress, and shamanic rituals. Explore the village's narrow stone pathways, ancient water mills, and the Gurung Museum to deepen your cultural understanding.

experiences.name: Mardi Himal Off-the-Beaten-Path Trek
experiences.description: Explore the lesser-known Mardi Himal trail, a hidden gem that offers solitude and raw Himalayan beauty away from crowded routes. Trek through dense bamboo and rhododendron forests to High Camp at 3,580m, where close-up views of Machapuchare (Fishtail Mountain) and Mardi Himal await. Encounter diverse wildlife including Himalayan tahr, langur monkeys, and rare bird species along the way.

experiences.name: Birethanti to Tikhedhunga Nature Walk & Waterfall
experiences.description: Begin your Annapurna Circuit adventure with a scenic nature walk from Birethanti along the Bhurungdi Khola river gorge to the stunning Tikhedhunga waterfall. Spot exotic birds including Himalayan monals, eagles, and colorful sunbirds in the subtropical forest. Enjoy freshly brewed Nepali milk tea and sel roti (rice doughnuts) at a riverside teahouse while soaking in the lush green landscape.
experiences.location: Birethanti to Tikhedhunga, Annapurna Conservation Area

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Annapurna, Nepal
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no afternoon activities scheduled
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 22:30. Clear immigration, collect baggage, and arrange a pre-booked budget taxi or airport bus to your accommodation. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, freshen up, and get a good night's rest to prepare for the trek ahead.

meals.breakfast: Skip or grab a snack on the plane
meals.lunch: Skip or eat at the airport
meals.dinner: Quick late-night dal bhat or noodle soup at a local 24-hour eatery near the resort (~$3–5 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Arrival day only. Do not schedule any strenuous activity. Exchange a small amount of currency at the airport (USD to NPR). Buy a local SIM card if needed. Keep receipts for all expenses.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up, have breakfast at the resort or a nearby local teahouse. Visit Pokhara lakeside area (Phewa Lake) for a gentle orientation walk. Explore the market streets, pick up any last-minute trekking supplies (gloves, snacks, water purification tablets) from budget shops on Lakeside Road.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the International Mountain Museum (entry ~$5 USD) to learn about Himalayan peaks and trekking history. Stroll through the Bindhyabasini Temple area for a cultural experience. Rent a rowboat on Phewa Lake (~$3–4/hour) for stunning Annapurna range views.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the Lakeside Bazaar for budget souvenir shopping. Watch the sunset over Phewa Lake from the shoreline. Enjoy dinner at a local Nepali restaurant on Lakeside Road.

meals.breakfast: Dal bhat set at a local teahouse near the resort (~$3 USD)
meals.lunch: Momo (dumplings) and lemon tea at a street stall (~$2–3 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat thali at a local Nepali restaurant (~$4–5 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Acclimatization and preparation day. Pokhara sits at ~820m elevation. Buy a TIMS card and Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP) today from the Nepal Tourism Board office (~$30 total). Confirm trekking route and pack your bag for tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Early breakfast and depart Pokhara by local bus or shared jeep to Nayapul (~1.5 hours, ~$2–3 USD). Begin the classic Annapurna Circuit / Poon Hill trek. Start trekking from Nayapul (1,070m) through lush rhododendron forests toward Tikhedhunga (1,540m). Enjoy views of terraced rice fields and Modi Khola river valley.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking uphill from Tikhedhunga through dense forest to Ulleri (2,073m). This section involves a steep stone staircase (~3,000 steps) — take it slow and steady. Rest at Ulleri and enjoy panoramic views of the Annapurna South face.
day_by_day.evening: Check in to a budget teahouse/guesthouse in Ulleri (~$3–5/night). Rest tired legs, hydrate well, and interact with fellow trekkers. Enjoy the peaceful mountain village atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Porridge or eggs with tea at the resort before departure (~$3 USD)
meals.lunch: Vegetable noodle soup or fried rice at a teahouse in Tikhedhunga (~$3–4 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at the Ulleri teahouse (~$4–5 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Trek distance: ~10–12 km, ~5–6 hours. Wear broken-in trekking boots. Carry at least 2 liters of water. October weather is generally clear and cool — ideal trekking season. Teahouse accommodation is very basic but sufficient for budget travel.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning rise to catch sunrise views over Annapurna South from Ulleri. After breakfast, continue trekking through rhododendron and oak forests toward Ghorepani (2,874m). The trail is moderately steep with beautiful forest scenery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani by early afternoon (~4–5 hours trekking). Check in to a budget teahouse. Rest and explore the small village. Visit the local tea shops and chat with other trekkers.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset walk to the edge of the ridge for views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges. Return to teahouse for dinner. Prepare gear and set an early alarm for the Poon Hill sunrise hike tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Porridge with honey and tea at Ulleri teahouse (~$3 USD)
meals.lunch: Garlic soup and chapati at a trail teahouse (~$3–4 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat with vegetable curry at Ghorepani teahouse (~$4–5 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Trek distance: ~8 km, ~4–5 hours. Elevation gain is significant — walk slowly and drink plenty of water. Ghorepani can be cold at night (near freezing in October). Bring a warm sleeping bag liner. Teahouse stay ~$4–6/night.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn wake-up at 4:30 AM. Hike to Poon Hill viewpoint (3,210m) — approximately 45 minutes uphill with a headlamp. Watch the spectacular sunrise over Dhaulagiri (8,167m), Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail). Return to Ghorepani for breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: After breakfast, continue trekking toward Tadapani (2,630m) through dense rhododendron forest. The trail offers stunning views of Machhapuchhre and the Modi Khola valley. Arrive at Tadapani by early afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at Tadapani teahouse and enjoy views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Journal, read, or socialize with fellow trekkers. Enjoy a warm dinner and early bedtime.

meals.breakfast: Hot lemon tea on Poon Hill, then eggs and toast back at Ghorepani (~$3–4 USD)
meals.lunch: Vegetable fried rice or pasta at a trail teahouse (~$3–4 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or noodle soup at Tadapani teahouse (~$4–5 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill entry fee ~$2 USD. Bring a headlamp and extra warm layers for the pre-dawn hike. Trek distance today: ~12 km, ~5–6 hours total. October mornings are crystal clear — perfect for photography. Teahouse stay ~$4–6/night.

day_by_day.morning: Morning trek from Tadapani descending through forests toward Chhomrong (2,170m). The trail passes through Gurung villages with traditional stone houses. Enjoy views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre throughout the descent.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Chhomrong, one of the last major villages before the Annapurna Sanctuary. Explore the village, visit the local gompa (Buddhist monastery), and check in to a budget teahouse. Rest and acclimatize.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll through Chhomrong village and enjoy the terraced hillside scenery. Watch the alpenglow on Annapurna South at sunset. Relax with fellow trekkers over hot tea.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Tadapani teahouse (~$3 USD)
meals.lunch: Momo and lemon tea at a Chhomrong teahouse (~$3–4 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat with spinach curry at Chhomrong teahouse (~$4–5 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Trek distance: ~10 km, ~5 hours. Chhomrong has a checkpoint — show your ACAP permit. Stock up on snacks and water purification tablets here as prices increase further up the trail. Teahouse stay ~$4–6/night.

day_by_day.morning: Early start from Chhomrong, descend stone steps to the Chhomrong Khola river, then ascend steeply to Sinuwa (2,360m). Continue through bamboo and rhododendron forest to Bamboo (2,310m) and then Dovan (2,600m).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking upward through increasingly dramatic gorge scenery to Himalaya Hotel (2,920m). The trail follows the Modi Khola river through a narrow gorge with towering rock walls. Check in to a basic teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at Himalaya Hotel teahouse. The gorge creates a dramatic, enclosed atmosphere. Listen to the roaring river below. Enjoy dinner and prepare for the high-altitude section tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and chapati at Chhomrong teahouse (~$3 USD)
meals.lunch: Garlic soup and rice at Bamboo teahouse (~$3–4 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Himalaya Hotel teahouse (~$5–6 USD — prices rise with altitude)

day_by_day.notes: Trek distance: ~12 km, ~6 hours. This is a long trekking day — start early. The gorge section can be cold and misty. Garlic soup is recommended to help with altitude acclimatization. Teahouse stay ~$5–7/night. Water from streams must be purified or buy bottled water.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Himalaya Hotel through Hinku Cave (3,170m) and Deurali (3,230m). The trail enters the Annapurna Sanctuary — a glacial amphitheater surrounded by 7,000–8,000m peaks. Stunning views begin to open up dramatically.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Annapurna Base Camp (ABC, 4,130m) — the highlight of the trek! You are surrounded by Annapurna I, Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Machhapuchhre, Gangapurna, and Glacier Dome. Spend time absorbing the incredible views and exploring around the camp.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset alpenglow on the surrounding peaks from ABC. This is one of the most spectacular natural light shows in the Himalayas. Celebrate your achievement with fellow trekkers over hot drinks.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Himalaya Hotel (~$3–4 USD)
meals.lunch: Hot noodle soup at Deurali teahouse (~$4–5 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at ABC teahouse (~$6–8 USD — highest altitude prices)

day_by_day.notes: Trek distance: ~10 km, ~5–6 hours. ABC sits at 4,130m — altitude sickness is possible. Walk slowly, drink 3–4 liters of water, avoid alcohol. If you experience severe headache, nausea, or confusion, descend immediately. Temperatures at ABC can drop to -10°C at night in October. Teahouse stay ~$6–8/night.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn wake-up for the sunrise at ABC — one of the most breathtaking experiences in the Himalayas. Watch the peaks turn gold and pink in the early light. Take photos, meditate, or simply soak in the moment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin descent from ABC back toward Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC, 3,700m) and continue down to Dovan (2,600m). Descending is significantly faster and easier on the lungs.
day_by_day.evening: Check in to a teahouse at Dovan. Enjoy the warmer, lower altitude air. Rest tired muscles and reflect on the incredible ABC experience.

meals.breakfast: Hot lemon tea and porridge at ABC teahouse (~$4–5 USD)
meals.lunch: Vegetable soup and bread at MBC or trail teahouse (~$4–5 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Dovan teahouse (~$5–6 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Descent distance: ~14 km, ~5–6 hours. Knees take a beating on the descent — use trekking poles if available. October mornings at ABC are magical and clear. Begin descent by 9 AM to reach Dovan before dark. Teahouse stay ~$4–6/night.

day_by_day.morning: Continue descent from Dovan through Bamboo and Sinuwa back to Chhomrong. The familiar trail feels different on the way back with new perspective. Enjoy the lush forest scenery and warmer temperatures.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive back in Chhomrong. Rest, do laundry, and recharge. Visit the small bakeries and cafes for a treat — Chhomrong has some surprisingly good apple pie and cinnamon rolls for trekkers.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a well-deserved rest evening in Chhomrong. Hot shower available at most teahouses (~$2–3 USD extra). Enjoy the village atmosphere and stunning Annapurna South views.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and toast at Dovan teahouse (~$3–4 USD)
meals.lunch: Fried rice and lemon tea at a Sinuwa teahouse (~$3–4 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat and vegetable curry at Chhomrong teahouse (~$4–5 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Trek distance: ~12 km, ~5 hours. A hot shower in Chhomrong is a luxury worth the small extra cost after days on the trail. Restock water and snacks here. Teahouse stay ~$4–6/night.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chhomrong back toward Ghandruk (1,940m) — a beautiful, large Gurung village. The trail descends through terraced fields and offers spectacular views of Machhapuchhre and Annapurna South. Ghandruk is one of the most scenic villages in the Annapurna region.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Ghandruk village — visit the Gurung Museum (entry ~$2 USD) to learn about local culture and traditions. Walk through the stone-paved lanes, admire traditional Gurung architecture, and enjoy the panoramic Himalayan views.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset over the Annapurna range from Ghandruk's hilltop viewpoints. Relax at a teahouse and enjoy the vibrant village atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Chhomrong teahouse (~$3 USD)
meals.lunch: Momo and garlic soup at a Ghandruk teahouse (~$3–4 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat with local Gurung-style vegetables at a Ghandruk teahouse (~$4–5 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Trek distance: ~8 km, ~4 hours. Ghandruk is a large, well-developed village with good teahouse options. It's a popular stop on the Annapurna Circuit and Poon Hill loop. Teahouse stay ~$4–6/night. Ghandruk also has a direct jeep track to Pokhara if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely morning in Ghandruk — final sunrise views over Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre. After breakfast, begin trekking or take a local jeep down to Nayapul, then catch a bus or shared jeep back to Pokhara (~2 hours, ~$3–4 USD).
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive back in Pokhara. Check back in to Aegean Bliss Resort. Take a long, hot shower and rest. Visit a local pharmacy if needed for any post-trek muscle relief. Stroll along Lakeside Road and enjoy being back in civilization.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the completion of your Annapurna trek! Enjoy a nice dinner at a budget Lakeside restaurant with mountain views. Watch the reflection of Machhapuchhre in Phewa Lake at dusk.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and toast at Ghandruk teahouse (~$3 USD)
meals.lunch: Snack on the bus — local biscuits and juice (~$1–2 USD)
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner: pizza or pasta at a Lakeside budget restaurant (~$5–7 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Return day from trek. Total trekking days: 9 days. Budget jeep from Ghandruk to Nayapul ~$5–8 USD (shared). Wash and dry trekking clothes today. Treat yourself to a budget massage on Lakeside Road (~$10–15 USD) — well-deserved after 9 days of trekking!

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning at the resort. Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed breakfast. Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — hike up (~45 minutes) or take a boat across Phewa Lake and hike up for panoramic views of Pokhara, Phewa Lake, and the entire Annapurna range.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Seti Gorge viewpoints near Pokhara — a dramatic natural gorge where the Seti River flows underground. Visit the Devi's Fall (Patale Chhango) waterfall (~$2 entry) and the adjacent Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave. Budget-friendly natural attractions.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening shopping at Lakeside Bazaar — pick up budget souvenirs like Thangka paintings, singing bowls, prayer flags, and handmade goods. Enjoy a farewell Nepali dinner with live folk music at a local restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Pancakes and honey with masala tea at a Lakeside cafe (~$3–4 USD)
meals.lunch: Thakali set meal (traditional Nepali cuisine) at a local restaurant (~$4–5 USD)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat with live Nepali folk music at a cultural restaurant (~$5–6 USD)

day_by_day.notes: World Peace Pagoda boat fare: ~$1–2 USD each way. Devi's Fall entry: ~$2 USD. Budget souvenir shopping tip: always bargain politely — start at 50% of the asking price. Pack souvenirs carefully to avoid damage. Confirm return transport arrangements for tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Pokhara/Nepal. Wake up early for one last sunrise view of the Annapurna range from the resort or Lakeside. Enjoy a relaxed final breakfast. Pack all belongings and check out of Aegean Bliss Resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure flight time: if flying from Pokhara Airport, transfer is short (~10 minutes). If returning to Kathmandu, take a tourist bus (~$10–12 USD, ~6–7 hours) or domestic flight (~$80–100 USD, 25 minutes). Allow extra time for Kathmandu traffic if connecting to an international flight.
day_by_day.evening: If time permits before departure, explore Thamel district in Kathmandu for last-minute shopping or a final Nepali meal. Depart Nepal with incredible memories of the Annapurna region, trekking achievements, and Himalayan landscapes.

meals.breakfast: Final dal bhat or eggs and toast at a Lakeside cafe (~$3–4 USD)
meals.lunch: Quick meal at Pokhara Airport or a Lakeside restaurant before departure (~$4–5 USD)
meals.dinner: Airport meal or in-flight meal on departure

day_by_day.notes: Departure day. Keep all trekking permits and receipts as souvenirs. Ensure passport, boarding pass, and valuables are in hand luggage. Nepal departure tax is typically included in international flight tickets. Tip your teahouse hosts and local guides if you used any — it makes a significant difference to their livelihoods. Budget tip: tourist bus Pokhara–Kathmandu is the most budget-friendly option at ~$10–12 USD.

trip_options.title: Classic Annapurna, Nepal Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at 22:30 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrival at 22:30 — no afternoon activities scheduled
day_by_day.evening: Late arrival at Kathmandu/Pokhara airport at 22:30. Transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort in the Annapurna region. Check in, freshen up, and get a good night's rest to prepare for the trek ahead.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or pre-arrival)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in-flight or pre-arrival)
meals.dinner: Light snack or room service at the resort upon arrival if available

day_by_day.notes: Keep luggage light and organized for early trekking days. Confirm trekking permits (TIMS card and Annapurna Conservation Area Permit) can be arranged the next morning. Stay hydrated after the flight.

day_by_day.morning: Recovery morning — sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Spend time orienting yourself to the surroundings, reviewing maps of the Annapurna region, and arranging trekking permits with the resort's help or a nearby trekking agency.
day_by_day.afternoon: Short acclimatization walk around the resort's immediate area and nearby village trails. Explore the local bazaar, pick up any last-minute trekking supplies (snacks, water purification tablets, trekking poles if needed), and soak in first views of the Annapurna range.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the lakeside (if near Pokhara/Phewa Lake area) or resort gardens at sunset. Enjoy the golden hour views of the Himalayas. Retire early for an early start tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast — eggs, toast, fresh fruit, and Nepali tea
meals.lunch: Local teahouse near the bazaar — Dal Bhat (lentil soup with rice) or momos (dumplings), approx. $5–8
meals.dinner: Mid-range restaurant near the resort — try Nepali thali set or pasta, approx. $8–12

day_by_day.notes: Obtain TIMS card and Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP) today — essential for trekking. Cost approx. $30–40 USD total. Begin drinking plenty of water to acclimatize to the altitude.

day_by_day.morning: Early start — drive or take a local jeep/bus to the trailhead at Nayapul or Tikhedhunga (approx. 1.5–2 hours from Pokhara). Begin the classic Annapurna Circuit or Poon Hill trek. Morning hike through lush subtropical forests, terraced rice fields, and traditional Gurung villages.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking upward through Birethanti and Hile toward Tikhedhunga or Ulleri. The trail passes stone-paved staircases and cascading waterfalls. Arrive at your teahouse accommodation by mid-afternoon. Rest and explore the village.
day_by_day.evening: Warm up by the teahouse fire. Chat with fellow trekkers and your guide. Watch the alpenglow on the Annapurna peaks at dusk.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast before departure — porridge, eggs, and Nepali tea
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch on the trail — vegetable noodle soup or fried rice, approx. $4–6
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner — Dal Bhat (unlimited refills), approx. $5–8

day_by_day.notes: Wear layers — mornings are cool in October but afternoons can be warm on lower trails. October is peak trekking season with clear skies and excellent mountain views. Trekking pace: moderate (4–6 hours walking).

day_by_day.morning: Early morning departure from Tikhedhunga/Ulleri. Trek through rhododendron and oak forests toward Ghorepani. The trail offers increasingly dramatic views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna South as you gain altitude.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Ghorepani (2,874m) by early afternoon. Check into a teahouse, rest, and acclimatize. Take a short exploratory walk around the village to stretch your legs and visit the local prayer flags and mani stones.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset views from Ghorepani's hilltop vantage points. Enjoy the crisp mountain air and a warm dinner. Prepare for the pre-dawn Poon Hill hike tomorrow — set your alarm for 4:30 AM.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast — porridge with honey, boiled eggs, and ginger tea
meals.lunch: Trail teahouse — garlic soup (great for altitude) and chapati with vegetables, approx. $4–6
meals.dinner: Ghorepani teahouse — Dal Bhat or pasta with vegetable curry, approx. $6–9

day_by_day.notes: Altitude at Ghorepani is 2,874m — some trekkers may feel mild breathlessness. Drink garlic soup (a local remedy) and stay well hydrated. Avoid alcohol at altitude. Pack your headlamp for tomorrow's pre-dawn hike.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn wake-up at 4:30 AM. Hike 45 minutes to Poon Hill (3,210m) by headlamp to witness one of Nepal's most iconic sunrises — a 360-degree panorama of Annapurna I, Annapurna South, Dhaulagiri, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), and Nilgiri bathed in golden light. Return to Ghorepani for breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Trek from Ghorepani through dense rhododendron forests toward Tadapani (3,630m). The trail offers continued spectacular mountain views. Arrive at Tadapani teahouse by early afternoon and rest.
day_by_day.evening: Relax on the teahouse terrace with views of Machhapuchhre. Journal your experiences, star-gaze in the exceptionally clear October skies.

meals.breakfast: Post-Poon Hill breakfast at Ghorepani teahouse — pancakes, eggs, and hot chocolate
meals.lunch: Trail teahouse between Ghorepani and Tadapani — noodle soup or fried rice, approx. $4–6
meals.dinner: Tadapani teahouse — Dal Bhat or vegetable stew with rice, approx. $6–8

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill sunrise is the highlight of the Ghorepani-Poon Hill circuit — one of the most photographed spots in Nepal. Bring warm layers for the pre-dawn hike (temperatures can drop to 0–5°C). Camera batteries drain fast in cold — keep them warm in your pocket.

day_by_day.morning: Morning trek from Tadapani descending through beautiful forests toward Chhomrong (2,170m), a charming Gurung village with stunning views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. The trail involves some steep stone steps.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Chhomrong village — visit the local school, Buddhist monastery, and traditional stone houses. The village offers panoramic views of the Annapurna Sanctuary entrance. Rest at your teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the warm afternoon sun on the terrace. Watch local village life unfold. Clear October evenings offer brilliant stargazing.

meals.breakfast: Tadapani teahouse — Tibetan bread with jam and butter, and masala tea
meals.lunch: Chhomrong teahouse — pizza (surprisingly good in mountain teahouses!) or pasta, approx. $5–7
meals.dinner: Chhomrong teahouse — Dal Bhat with local vegetables and pickle, approx. $6–9

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong is the last major village before the Annapurna Sanctuary (Base Camp route). If you plan to continue to ABC, today is a good day to check weather forecasts and consult your guide. Trekking day: moderate (5–6 hours).

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chhomrong descending to the Modi Khola river and ascending through bamboo and rhododendron forests toward Dovan (2,600m) or Himalaya Hotel. The trail enters the dramatic Modi Khola gorge — a narrow valley flanked by towering peaks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking to Deurali (3,230m) if energy permits, or rest at Himalaya Hotel. The landscape transitions from forest to alpine terrain. Watch for Himalayan tahr (wild mountain goats) on the rocky slopes.
day_by_day.evening: Cozy teahouse evening — play cards with fellow trekkers, share trail stories, and enjoy the peaceful mountain atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Chhomrong teahouse — porridge with dried fruit and hot lemon honey tea
meals.lunch: Himalaya Hotel teahouse — vegetable soup and chapati, approx. $4–6
meals.dinner: Dovan/Himalaya Hotel teahouse — Dal Bhat or pasta, approx. $6–8

day_by_day.notes: This section of trail can be prone to avalanche risk in winter, but October is generally safe. Always follow your guide's advice. The gorge section is narrow and spectacular — have your camera ready. Altitude increasing — hydration is key.

day_by_day.morning: The most dramatic day of the trek — hike from Deurali through the high-altitude alpine zone past Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m) toward Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m). The trail opens into the stunning Annapurna Sanctuary — a natural amphitheater surrounded by 7,000m+ peaks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) — one of the most awe-inspiring locations in the Himalayas. You are surrounded by Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Gangapurna, Glacier Dome, and Machhapuchhre. Spend the afternoon exploring the base camp area, taking photos, and soaking in the incredible scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at ABC — watch the peaks turn pink and orange in the alpenglow. This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. The temperature drops sharply after sunset — layer up immediately.

meals.breakfast: Deurali teahouse — eggs, toast, and hot ginger tea for energy
meals.lunch: Machhapuchhre Base Camp teahouse — hot soup and snacks, approx. $5–7
meals.dinner: ABC teahouse — Dal Bhat (carb-heavy for altitude energy), approx. $8–12

day_by_day.notes: This is the highest point of the trek at 4,130m. Altitude sickness is possible — symptoms include headache, nausea, and dizziness. Descend immediately if symptoms are severe. October weather at ABC is generally clear and cold (0°C to -10°C at night). Celebrate reaching ABC — you've earned it!

day_by_day.morning: Wake up at dawn for the spectacular ABC sunrise — Annapurna I glowing in the first light is unforgettable. Take final photos and begin descent from ABC back through Machhapuchhre Base Camp toward Bamboo (2,310m).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue descending through the Modi Khola gorge, passing through Dovan and Himalaya Hotel. The descent is faster than the ascent — enjoy the changing landscapes as you re-enter the forest zone.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Bamboo teahouse. Rest tired legs, enjoy a warm meal, and celebrate a successful ABC trek.

meals.breakfast: ABC teahouse — porridge and hot chocolate before the descent
meals.lunch: Trail teahouse — noodle soup or fried rice, approx. $4–6
meals.dinner: Bamboo teahouse — Dal Bhat with extra helpings (you deserve it!), approx. $6–8

day_by_day.notes: Descending from altitude — knees take extra strain on the way down. Use trekking poles if available. The descent from ABC to Bamboo is approximately 6–7 hours. Enjoy the relief of lower altitude and thicker air.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Bamboo back up to Chhomrong, retracing steps through the lush forest. The familiar trail feels different on the return journey — notice details you may have missed on the way up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Chhomrong down toward Jhinu Danda (1,780m), a small village famous for its natural hot springs on the banks of the Modi Khola river.
day_by_day.evening: Soak in the Jhinu Danda natural hot springs — the perfect reward after days of trekking! The warm mineral-rich waters soothe tired muscles. Watch the sunset from the hot springs with mountain views.

meals.breakfast: Bamboo teahouse — Tibetan bread with peanut butter and tea
meals.lunch: Chhomrong teahouse — pasta or vegetable curry with rice, approx. $5–7
meals.dinner: Jhinu Danda teahouse — Dal Bhat or pizza, approx. $6–9

day_by_day.notes: The Jhinu Danda hot springs are a beloved highlight for trekkers — don't miss them! Small entry fee of approx. $2–3. The springs are open-air beside the river — bring a towel and flip-flops. This is one of the most relaxing evenings of the entire trip.

day_by_day.morning: Final trekking day — hike from Jhinu Danda through Siwai and Landruk village back toward the Nayapul trailhead. The trail passes through beautiful terraced farmland with views of Machhapuchhre. A fitting, scenic conclusion to the trek.
day_by_day.afternoon: Reach Nayapul and arrange transport back to Pokhara (approx. 1.5 hours by jeep or bus). Arrive in Pokhara and return to Aegean Bliss Resort. Shower, unpack, and relish the comfort of a proper bed.
day_by_day.evening: Celebratory dinner in Pokhara's Lakeside district to mark the completion of the Annapurna trek. Explore the vibrant Lakeside area with its cafes, shops, and restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Jhinu Danda teahouse — eggs and toast with fresh orange juice
meals.lunch: Trail teahouse near Landruk — noodle soup or fried rice, approx. $4–6
meals.dinner: Pokhara Lakeside restaurant — celebration dinner with pizza, pasta, or Nepali cuisine, approx. $10–15

day_by_day.notes: You have completed the Annapurna trek — a major achievement! Reflect on the journey. Consider purchasing a certificate of completion from the TIMS office in Pokhara. Treat yourself to a proper massage at one of Pokhara's many affordable massage centers (~$10–15/hour).

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day in Pokhara. Sleep in, enjoy a long breakfast, and visit the International Mountain Museum — a world-class museum dedicated to the Himalayas, mountaineering history, and the cultures of mountain peoples.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a kayak or rowboat on Phewa Lake and paddle out to the iconic Tal Barahi Temple on an island in the middle of the lake. Enjoy stunning reflections of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain) on the calm lake surface.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset boat ride on Phewa Lake or watch the sunset from the Lakeside promenade. Browse the Lakeside shops for trekking souvenirs, pashmina scarves, Thangka paintings, and handmade jewelry.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — full buffet with fresh fruit, eggs, and Nepali tea
meals.lunch: Lakeside cafe — club sandwich, fresh juice, and dessert, approx. $7–10
meals.dinner: Mid-range Lakeside restaurant — try Newari cuisine or Continental, approx. $10–14

day_by_day.notes: International Mountain Museum entry fee approx. $5. Rowboat rental on Phewa Lake approx. $5–7/hour. October light on the lake is magical — bring your camera. This is a perfect active rest day after the trek.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — hike or take a boat across Phewa Lake and then a 30-minute hike up to this beautiful white Buddhist stupa with panoramic views of the Annapurna range, Pokhara city, and Phewa Lake.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave and Davis Falls (Patale Chhango) — a dramatic waterfall that disappears underground into a cave system. Explore the cave and learn about local Hindu mythology. Afternoon at leisure — spa, shopping, or relaxing at the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at one of Pokhara's best mid-range restaurants. Reflect on the 14-day journey with a special meal. Pack bags for departure tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Lakeside cafe — French toast with banana and honey, and fresh coffee
meals.lunch: Restaurant near Davis Falls — Dal Bhat set meal or momos, approx. $5–8
meals.dinner: Special farewell dinner at a rooftop Lakeside restaurant — multi-course Nepali or Continental meal, approx. $12–18

day_by_day.notes: World Peace Pagoda boat crossing approx. $3. Davis Falls entry fee approx. $2. Consider booking a 60-minute traditional Nepali massage at the resort or a Lakeside spa as a final treat (~$12–15). Pack any trekking gear you won't need for the journey home.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Nepal. Wake up for one last sunrise view of the Annapurna range from the resort or lakeside. Enjoy a leisurely final breakfast. Take a short morning walk along the lakeside promenade to say goodbye to Pokhara.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Transfer to Pokhara Airport for a domestic flight back to Kathmandu (if applicable), or arrange road/air transfer for international departure. Allow extra time for Nepal's variable transport schedules.
day_by_day.evening: Departure preparations. If time permits in Kathmandu, visit Thamel for last-minute shopping or a final meal. Board your international flight home with incredible memories of the Annapurna region.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy every bite with a view of the mountains
meals.lunch: Airport cafe or Thamel restaurant — momos or Nepali thali, approx. $5–8
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or in-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before international departure for check-in and security. Nepal's airports can be busy — arrive early. Declare any items purchased over customs limits. Carry trekking permits and experience certificates as wonderful souvenirs. Namaste — and thank you, Nepal!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Annapurna, Nepal Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of the most spectacular sunrises in the Himalayas. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a panoramic 180-degree view. The 2-hour ascent from Ghorepani is manageable for most fitness levels and rewards trekkers with unforgettable Himalayan vistas.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 22:30. Private luxury transfer arranged to your hotel in Pokhara or Kathmandu for overnight rest. No activities scheduled — focus on rest and recovery after long-haul flight.
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — in-flight or transit.
day_by_day.evening: Late-night arrival. Check-in to luxury transit accommodation near Kathmandu airport or begin private vehicle/helicopter transfer toward Annapurna region. Light welcome amenity and room service available upon arrival.

meals.breakfast: In-flight or airport lounge dining
meals.lunch: In-flight or airport lounge dining
meals.dinner: Light room service at transit hotel — request traditional Nepali dal bhat or a light Western option to ease into the time zone

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is late at 22:30. No sightseeing or trekking activities are scheduled for Day 1. Ensure all luggage is confirmed, and coordinate with your private guide/concierge for the next day's briefing. Stay hydrated and rest well.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely morning at your transit accommodation. After a gourmet breakfast, take a private scenic drive or chartered helicopter transfer to the Annapurna region and check in to Aegean Bliss Resort. Settle into your Beachfront suite overlooking the stunning Annapurna landscape and Phewa Lake surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Orientation walk around the resort grounds with your personal guide. Explore the immediate lakeside and mountain-facing trails at a gentle pace to begin acclimatization. Visit the resort's panoramic viewing deck for your first awe-inspiring views of the Annapurna massif.
day_by_day.evening: Welcome dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant. Enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring Nepali-inspired haute cuisine with Himalayan ingredients paired with premium wines.

meals.breakfast: Full gourmet breakfast at transit hotel — eggs Benedict, fresh fruit, Nepali honey, artisan breads and freshly brewed Himalayan tea
meals.lunch: Light in-transit meal or welcome lunch at Aegean Bliss Resort — grilled mountain trout, garden salads, and Newari-inspired small plates
meals.dinner: Welcome tasting dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant — seven-course Nepali-fusion menu with Himalayan herb-crusted lamb, yak cheese platters, and saffron kheer for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Take it easy today. Mild acclimatization walk only. Drink plenty of water and avoid alcohol on the first evening to help your body adjust to the altitude. Confirm trekking gear and equipment with the resort concierge.

day_by_day.morning: After an early gourmet breakfast, embark on a guided nature hike along the Annapurna foothills trail near the resort. Explore lush rhododendron forests, terraced farmland, and gurgling mountain streams. Spot local bird species including Himalayan Monal and eagles with your expert naturalist guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a post-hike Himalayan herbal spa treatment. Enjoy a traditional Nepali Panchkarma massage or hot stone therapy using locally sourced herbs and oils. Relax by the infinity pool overlooking the Annapurna range.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's sky lounge with panoramic mountain views. Followed by a private candlelit dinner on your beachfront terrace under a canopy of Himalayan stars.

meals.breakfast: Lavish buffet breakfast at the resort — fresh juices, Himalayan granola, eggs to order, Tibetan bread with local honey and butter
meals.lunch: Packed premium picnic lunch on the trail — artisan sandwiches, local cheeses, seasonal fruits, energy bars, and thermos of Nepali masala chai
meals.dinner: Private beachfront terrace dinner — pan-seared Himalayan trout, roasted vegetable momos, saffron risotto, and dark chocolate fondant with cardamom ice cream

day_by_day.notes: Today's hike is moderate and ideal for initial acclimatization. Wear layered clothing as morning temperatures can be cool. Sunscreen and sunglasses are essential at this altitude.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning guided kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding on Phewa Lake with the Annapurna and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) peaks reflected on the glassy water. A truly magical and exclusive experience arranged privately by the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) via a guided forest hike. Enjoy sweeping 360-degree views of Pokhara, Phewa Lake, and the Annapurna range from this stunning hilltop Buddhist monument. Private guide provides cultural and historical context.
day_by_day.evening: Cultural evening at the resort — enjoy a private performance of traditional Gurung and Newari music and dance arranged exclusively for premium guests. Post-performance, enjoy a chef's table dinner with the resort's head chef.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before lake activity — yogurt parfait with Himalayan berries, avocado toast, green smoothie, and Darjeeling tea
meals.lunch: Lakeside gourmet lunch at a curated restaurant in Pokhara — fresh grilled fish, Newari set meal, and local craft beer or sparkling water
meals.dinner: Chef's table dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — five-course personalized menu crafted by the head chef using seasonal local produce, with wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: October is peak season with clear skies and excellent mountain visibility. The lake activity is best in early morning when winds are calm. Bring a light rain jacket just in case.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day guided trek to the Annapurna Sanctuary base area — begin early with a private vehicle transfer to the trailhead. Trek through terraced fields, traditional Gurung villages, and dense subtropical forests. Your expert guide shares insights on local culture and ecology.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking through higher elevation terrain. Stop at a scenic ridgeline for a premium packed lunch with mountain panoramas. Spot rare Himalayan flora and fauna with your naturalist guide.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Unwind with a private yoga session on your beachfront terrace as the sun sets behind the Annapurna peaks. Followed by a restorative dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Hearty pre-trek breakfast — oatmeal with nuts and honey, scrambled eggs with herbs, whole grain toast, fresh juice, and Nepali milk tea
meals.lunch: Premium packed trail lunch — gourmet wraps, smoked salmon, mixed nuts, dark chocolate, and thermos of hot soup
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant dinner — slow-braised yak stew with Himalayan herbs, roasted root vegetables, warm bread, and mango kulfi for dessert

day_by_day.notes: This is a longer trekking day — approximately 6–8 hours of hiking. Wear broken-in trekking boots and carry trekking poles. The resort provides a fully equipped trekking kit for premium guests.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast with mountain views. Optional gentle lakeside stroll or meditation session with the resort's wellness guide in the garden.
day_by_day.afternoon: Exclusive private helicopter scenic flight over the Annapurna massif, Dhaulagiri, and Machhapuchhre peaks. Land at a high-altitude meadow for a champagne toast before returning to the resort. A once-in-a-lifetime aerial perspective of the Himalayas.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset rooftop cocktail hour at the resort's sky bar. Followed by a romantic dinner at the resort's lakeside pavilion with live acoustic guitar music.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent late breakfast — French toast with Himalayan honey, smoked salmon bagels, fresh tropical fruits, cold-pressed juices, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Light in-resort lunch before helicopter flight — mezze platter, fresh salads, sparkling water, and herbal teas
meals.dinner: Lakeside pavilion dinner — lobster bisque, grilled prime tenderloin with truffle butter, seasonal vegetables, and crème brûlée with Himalayan salt

day_by_day.notes: The helicopter flight is weather-dependent and may be rescheduled. The resort's concierge monitors conditions and will confirm the flight by 8:00 AM. Champagne and light snacks are provided during the mountain landing.

day_by_day.morning: Rise before dawn for the legendary Poon Hill Sunrise Hike. Private vehicle transfer to Ghorepani trailhead. Hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m elevation as the sky transitions from deep indigo to blazing gold, revealing the full Annapurna and Dhaulagiri panorama in breathtaking detail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend through rhododendron and oak forests, visiting the traditional village of Ghorepani. Interact with local Magar and Gurung families. Visit a local home for a private tea ceremony experience. Return to the resort by private vehicle.
day_by_day.evening: Celebratory dinner at the resort to mark the halfway point of your journey. Enjoy a special Himalayan tasting menu with rare Nepali wines and spirits.

meals.breakfast: Pre-dawn energy breakfast before departure — banana, energy bars, thermos of hot masala chai, and boiled eggs (full breakfast upon return)
meals.lunch: Gourmet packed mountain lunch at Poon Hill or on descent — artisan sandwiches, local pickles, seasonal fruits, nuts, and hot soup in a thermos
meals.dinner: Celebratory Himalayan tasting menu — Tibetan-style butter tea amuse-bouche, yak carpaccio, nettle soup, buckwheat noodles with mountain mushrooms, and cardamom panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: This is the highlight experience of the trip. Wake-up call at 3:30 AM. Dress in warm layers — temperatures at Poon Hill can drop to near freezing before sunrise. Headlamps provided by the resort. The views are absolutely worth the early start.

day_by_day.morning: Full rest and spa day. Begin with a private guided meditation and pranayama breathing session on the resort lawn facing the mountains. Follow with a 90-minute Ayurvedic full-body treatment at the resort's luxury spa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely afternoon exploring the resort's curated Himalayan art gallery and cultural library. Optional private cooking class with the resort's chef — learn to prepare authentic Nepali dishes including dal bhat, sel roti, and achar.
day_by_day.evening: Private rooftop stargazing session with a professional astronomer using high-powered telescopes. The Himalayan skies offer extraordinary clarity for celestial observation. Followed by a nightcap at the sky bar.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast — smoothie bowls, chia pudding, poached eggs on sourdough, herbal detox teas, and fresh coconut water
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch at the resort — quinoa salad, grilled vegetables, lemon-herb chicken, and freshly squeezed juices
meals.dinner: Rooftop dinner under the stars — Nepali thali with premium accompaniments, including saffron rice, slow-cooked lentils, mountain spinach, and assorted pickles

day_by_day.notes: Today is intentionally relaxed to allow physical recovery from the Poon Hill hike. The stargazing session begins at 8:30 PM — bring a warm fleece or the resort will provide blankets and hot chocolate.

day_by_day.morning: Guided nature photography walk along the Annapurna foothills with a professional wildlife and landscape photographer. Learn composition techniques while capturing stunning shots of the mountains, local villages, terraced rice paddies, and wildlife.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara — a world-class museum dedicated to the history of Himalayan mountaineering and the cultures of mountain peoples. Private guided tour with expert commentary.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell pre-dinner drinks at a curated rooftop bar in Lakeside Pokhara with panoramic lake and mountain views. Followed by dinner at one of Pokhara's finest restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Full gourmet breakfast at the resort — eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, fresh pastries, tropical fruit platter, and specialty Himalayan coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at a premium Pokhara restaurant — Newari feast with bara (lentil patties), chatamari, and local craft beverages
meals.dinner: Dinner at a top-rated Pokhara fine-dining restaurant — contemporary Nepali cuisine with international influences, including Himalayan herb-infused cocktails

day_by_day.notes: The photography walk is best in early morning light. Bring your camera or the resort can arrange a professional camera rental. The mountain museum visit takes approximately 2–3 hours and is highly recommended for context on the Annapurna region.

day_by_day.morning: Guided trek along the Annapurna Circuit lower section — explore the Modi Khola river valley, passing through traditional stone-paved trails, suspension bridges, and cascading waterfalls. Your guide shares botanical knowledge of the extraordinary Himalayan plant life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at the village of Landruk for a private cultural immersion — visit a traditional Gurung household, participate in a weaving demonstration, and enjoy local home-brewed raksi (millet spirit) and snacks with the family.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a private sunset yoga session on the beachfront deck. Followed by a relaxed dinner at the resort with a focus on Ayurvedic and nutritious Himalayan cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Pre-trek power breakfast — protein-rich scrambled eggs, whole grain pancakes with local honey, mixed nuts, fresh juice, and ginger tea
meals.lunch: Village-style lunch in Landruk — home-cooked dal bhat, seasonal vegetable curry, and local pickles prepared by the host family (arranged by resort)
meals.dinner: Ayurvedic dinner at the resort — turmeric-spiced lentil soup, steamed millet bread, sautéed Himalayan greens, and warm ginger-honey dessert

day_by_day.notes: The village cultural visit is a premium exclusive experience arranged by the resort. A donation to the local community school is included in your itinerary as part of the resort's responsible tourism commitment.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise hot air balloon flight over the Pokhara Valley and Phewa Lake — drift silently above the mist-covered lake as the Annapurna peaks glow in the morning light. Champagne breakfast served upon landing in a scenic meadow.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisure time at the resort. Enjoy the infinity pool, beachfront lounging, or optional water activities on Phewa Lake. Personal time for journaling, reading, or simply soaking in the extraordinary scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Private sunset boat cruise on Phewa Lake with the Annapurna reflection shimmering on the water. Canapés and premium beverages served on board. Followed by a gourmet dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Champagne breakfast in the meadow post-balloon landing — fresh croissants, smoked salmon, local cheeses, strawberries, and sparkling wine
meals.lunch: Light resort lunch — Mediterranean-style mezze, fresh salads, cold-pressed juices, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Lakeside gourmet dinner at the resort — seared duck breast with wild berry reduction, truffle potato gratin, seasonal greens, and chocolate lava cake

day_by_day.notes: The hot air balloon is weather-dependent and requires a minimum wind condition. The resort will confirm by 5:30 AM on the day. This is one of the most exclusive experiences of the trip — highly recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day guided high-altitude trek to Dhampus Peak viewpoint — one of the finest vantage points in the Annapurna region. Trek through pine and rhododendron forests with expert naturalist commentary. Enjoy extraordinary close-up views of Machhapuchhre and the Annapurna South face.
day_by_day.afternoon: Picnic lunch at the summit viewpoint. Spend time in contemplative silence absorbing the grandeur of the Himalayan landscape. Begin descent through the village of Dhampus — a traditional Gurung settlement with beautifully maintained stone houses.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Enjoy a long soak in your private suite's luxury bath with Himalayan bath salts. Followed by a quiet, indulgent dinner.

meals.breakfast: Hearty trekking breakfast — full English with Nepali accents, including spiced potato hash, eggs to order, fresh bread, and masala chai
meals.lunch: Premium summit picnic — gourmet sandwiches, imported cheeses, charcuterie, seasonal fruits, dark chocolate, and thermos of hot tomato soup
meals.dinner: Intimate resort dinner — Himalayan lamb chops with rosemary and garlic, roasted seasonal vegetables, saffron pilaf, and mango sorbet

day_by_day.notes: Dhampus trek is approximately 5–6 hours round trip with moderate elevation gain. Trekking poles are recommended. October weather is typically clear and stable — ideal conditions for mountain views.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely final full morning at the resort. Enjoy a sunrise meditation on the beachfront deck, followed by a long gourmet breakfast. Optional last nature walk along the lakeside trail with your guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Premium souvenir and artisan shopping experience in Pokhara — visit curated Thangka painting studios, pashmina workshops, and handcrafted jewelry boutiques with your personal shopping concierge who ensures authentic, high-quality purchases.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner at the resort — a spectacular multi-course celebration dinner with the resort's full culinary team. Receive a personalized memory book of your 14-day Annapurna journey prepared by the resort staff.

meals.breakfast: Celebration breakfast — eggs Florentine, smoked salmon blinis, fresh tropical fruits, artisan pastries, fresh-squeezed juices, and specialty Himalayan coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at a premium Pokhara café during shopping — light bites, gourmet salads, and artisan coffee
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner — amuse-bouche trio, Himalayan mushroom velouté, seared Annapurna trout, yak tenderloin with truffle jus, cheese course, and a decadent Himalayan chocolate dessert with gold leaf

day_by_day.notes: The resort will prepare a personalized memory book and a curated gift package of local Himalayan products (teas, spices, honey) for you to take home. Ensure all packing is completed tonight for an early departure.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise viewing from the resort's beachfront deck — a quiet, reflective moment to absorb the last views of the Annapurna massif. Enjoy a farewell breakfast at the resort with the full team bidding you goodbye.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer from Aegean Bliss Resort to Pokhara Airport or Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu for your departure flight. En-route, optional brief stop at a scenic viewpoint for a final photograph of the Himalayas.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Nepal. Reflect on an extraordinary 14-day premium Annapurna journey filled with world-class trekking, cultural immersion, and unparalleled Himalayan luxury.

meals.breakfast: Farewell breakfast at the resort — your personal favorite dishes from the trip, freshly prepared by the culinary team as a final gesture
meals.lunch: Airport lounge dining or in-flight premium meal
meals.dinner: In-flight premium dining

day_by_day.notes: Check-out formalities will be handled seamlessly by the resort concierge. All luggage will be transferred to the vehicle. A farewell gift and handwritten note from the resort manager will be presented at departure. Safe travels and namaste!
